description: This Java class 'KeyToMultiValue' models a key associated with multiple values, supporting various constructors, value manipulation methods, and equality/hash code implementations. It is part of the 'org.mockserver.model' package.

classes.name: KeyToMultiValue
classes.description: Represents a key with multiple associated values, supporting addition, replacement, and equality operations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the key name as a NottableString.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of associated values.

methods.name: replaceValues
methods.description: Replaces current values with a new list of values.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a single value to the list of values.

methods.name: addValues
methods.description: Adds multiple values to the list, accepting String or NottableString arrays.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on name and values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on name and values.
